1. Remember to save often! In many code editors, keyboard command to save any files is `Ctrl + S` or `CMD + S`.


2. Coming back to coding.

After you have saved all the changes to your files, you can comfortably close the code editor. 

When coming back, open the `webmap` folder again, and run the two latter npm commands in terminal.

```bash
cd my-app
npm start
```
This will re-deploy a local development server for you to see the live edits to your webmap.
